title: An External Provider Entry
description: The shape of a hosted, OpenAI-compatible provider. The key is a reference to an environment variable, never the value itself.

steps.description: This is an external provider entry, for an OpenAI-compatible service. The page says nothing in the course requires a paid provider; the shape is here because you will meet it, and because it is where the credential rule bites.
The provider is named `acmeai`. `npm` is the same adapter package, and `name` notes that this is an example, not a real service.
`options` holds the `baseURL` and an `apiKey` set to `"{env:ACME_API_KEY}"`. That is the name of a variable, not its value.
The page says the file holds the name of a variable, never its value. You set the value in your shell, or reference a file with `{file:~/.secrets/acme-key}`.

steps.question: The page says a configuration file that contains a key is a key you have done what?
